blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.
blocks.zh: 虹膜识别系统容易受到演示攻击(PAs)的伤害,包括纹理隐形眼镜,平面回放和合成虹膜. 现有的PAD方法依赖于有监督的学习,使用攻击数据,将通俗化限制在不可见的攻击和新的传感器上. 我们提出Diff-IrisPAD,这是一个基于布朗斯桥分流的无人监督的框架,在不使用攻击样本的情况下模拟善意的虹膜分布. 该方法从已退化的输入中重建出干净的虹膜纹理,并使用ViT分数和像素级测量方法通过重建不一致来检测攻击. 对大规模多传感器数据集(125K+图像,NNIS和VIS,8个攻击类型)的实验显示,Diff-IrisPAD总体实现30.52的ACER,显著地超越了基于扩散的基线,同时表现出了强烈的通俗化到不可见的攻击. 这些成果突出表明了以传播为基础的善意模型对于强健而可扩展的虹膜PAD的有效性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Iris recognition is one of the most reliable biometric technologies due to the distinctive and stable texture patterns of the human iris. It is widely deployed in applications such as border control, national identity systems, and mobile authentication [ 48 , 24 ] . Despite its success, iris recognition systems remain vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), where adversaries attempt to spoof the sensor using printed images, textured contact lenses, electronic displays, or synthetic irises [ 18 , 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于人类虹膜具有独特而稳定的纹理形态,虹膜识别是最可靠的生物鉴别技术之一. 它广泛用于边境管制、国家身份系统、移动认证等应用[48、24]。 尽管虹膜识别系统取得了成功,但仍然容易受到演示攻击,对手试图利用印刷图像、纹理隐形眼镜、电子显示器或合成虹膜对传感器进行扫描[18、45]。

blocks.en:
To mitigate these threats, iris Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) has been extensively studied. Early approaches relied on handcrafted features, including texture descriptors for detecting contact lenses [ 12 ] and multi-feature fusion strategies [ 22 ] , as well as imaging-based cues such as light field characteristics [ 32 ] . Benchmark efforts like LivDet-Iris [ 46 ] have further standardized evaluation and accelerated progress in this field. More recently, deep learning-based methods have significantly improved PAD performance by learning discriminative representations directly from data.
However, most existing PAD approaches follow a supervised learning paradigm that requires both bona fide and attack samples during training. This assumption is restrictive, as new and unseen attack types continuously emerge. Consequently, supervised models often overfit to known attacks and exhibit significant performance degradation under cross-sensor and unseen attack scenarios [ 46 , 6 , 43 ] . This challenge is further exacerbated by the increasing realism of attacks, including textured contact lenses, high-quality display attacks, post-mortem samples, and synthetic irises generated by modern generative models. These limitations highlight the need for approaches that can generalize beyond known attack categories.
Recent works attempt to address these challenges using open-set PAD and foundation model-based approaches [ 36 , 11 ] . While promising, these methods still rely on labeled attack data and do not fully solve the problem of generalization to unseen attacks. This motivates the need for fundamentally different approaches that model only bona fide data.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻这些威胁,广泛研究了虹膜表面攻击检测。 早期的方法依赖于手工制作的特征,包括用于探测隐形眼镜的纹理描述符[12]和多地貌聚变策略[22],以及基于图像的提示,如光场特征[32]. LivDet-Iris等基准工作使评价进一步标准化,并加快了这一领域的进展。 最近,深入的学习方法通过直接从数据中学习歧视性的表述,大大提高了方案支助发展的业绩。
然而,大多数现有的方案支助发展办法都遵循监督学习的模式,在培训期间既需要善意的样本,也需要攻击的样本。 这一假设是限制性的,因为新的和看不见的攻击类型不断出现。 因此,受监督的模型往往与已知攻击过度吻合,在交叉传感器和隐形攻击情况下表现严重退化[46、6、43]。 由于攻击的现实性日益增强,包括纹理隐形眼镜、高质量显示攻击、死后样品和现代基因模型产生的合成虹膜,使这一挑战进一步加剧。 这些局限性突出表明,需要采取超越已知攻击类别的办法。
近期的工程试图利用开放式的PAD和基于基础的模型方法应对这些挑战[36,11]. 这些方法虽然很有希望,但仍然依靠标注的攻击数据,不能完全解决泛化到隐形攻击的问题. 这就要求采取根本不同的做法,只模拟善意数据。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose Diff-IrisPAD , an unsupervised framework for iris PAD based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion. Unlike conventional diffusion models that learn noise-to-data mappings, BBDM enables a direct transformation between degraded and clean images, resulting in more efficient and stable reconstruction.
The proposed method models the distribution of bona fide iris images by learning to reconstruct clean iris textures from synthetically degraded inputs. During inference, both bona fide and attack samples are processed through the same reconstruction pipeline. Since the model is trained exclusively on bona fide data, it reconstructs genuine samples accurately while failing to reproduce attack-specific artifacts. This discrepancy is quantified using perceptual similarity metrics such as LPIPS [ 49 ] .
The proposed framework is inspired by diffusion-based anomaly detection [ 44 ] , but is specifically designed for iris PAD, addressing the challenges of fine-grained texture modeling and cross-attack generalization. Contributions. The main contributions of this work are: • Diff-IrisPAD : An unsupervised iris presentation attack detection framework based on BBDM, which models the distribution of bona fide iris images without requiring attack samples. • Reconstruction-based PAD formulation in latent space, where attacks are identified via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT metrics. • A latent diffusion architecture integrating a frozen VQGAN with a trainable BBDM, enabling efficient and stable learning of fine-grained iris texture representations. • An attack-agnostic learning paradigm that improves robustness to unseen presentation attacks by relying solely on bona fide data. • Extensive evaluation on a multi-sensor iris PAD dataset, demonstrating competitive performance and improved generalization compared to diffusion-based baselines.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep learning has significantly advanced iris Presentation Attack Detection (PAD), with early strong baselines shaping later research. A cascade-based CNN framework was introduced by [ 35 ] , where multiple specialised networks focus on different attack types and their outputs are fused hierarchically. While effective, this approach highlighted the need for richer feature representations, which motivated [ 1 ] to propose a dual-stream contraction–expansion CNN that jointly processes raw and edge-enhanced iris images to capture complementary cues and improve generalisation. Moving beyond single-task learning, [ 9 ] presented EyePAD++, a teacher–student framework that jointly learns iris recognition and PAD, showing that identity features can enhance spoof detection. Building on the need for robustness in real-world settings, [ 2 ] focused on generalised contact lens detection, addressing unseen lens types and demonstrating the importance of handling evolving attack patterns.
blocks.zh: 深层学习已经显著地推进了虹膜演示攻击探测(PAD),早期的强基线塑造了后来的研究. [35] 采用了基于级联的有线电视新闻网框架,其中多个专业网络侧重于不同的攻击类型,其产出分级连接。 这一方法虽然有效,但凸显出需要更丰富的特征表述,它促使[1]提出双流收缩-扩展CNN,联合处理原始的和边缘增强的虹膜图像,以捕捉互补的提示并改进泛化。 超越单任务学习,[9]提出了EyePAD++,一个师生框架,共同学习虹膜识别和PAD,表明身份特征可以增强spoof检测. 基于在现实世界环境中需要坚固性,[2]侧重于一般化的隐形镜头探测,处理看不见的镜头类型,并展示处理不断变化的攻击模式的重要性.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, a key challenge that emerged is domain shift, where models fail under unseen sensors or environments. [ 7 ] highlighted this limitation, showing that models performing well in controlled settings degrade significantly in cross-domain scenarios. To better understand this, [ 16 ] analysed cross-spectrum PAD across NIR and visible domains, revealing large performance gaps when models are evaluated across imaging conditions. Extending this, [ 15 ] studied data augmentation strategies and found that naïve combinations can harm performance, emphasising the need for structured augmentation. Addressing this issue, [ 26 ] proposed a Single Domain Dynamic Generalisation framework that simulates domain shifts using only one dataset, while [ 30 ] further improved robustness using adversarial augmentation to generate challenging training samples without requiring target-domain data.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但出现的一个关键挑战是域转移,即模型在看不见的传感器或环境中失效。 [7] 强调了这一局限性,表明在受控环境中表现良好的模型在跨域情景中显著降解。 为了更好地理解这一点,[16] 分析了跨国家清单报告和可见领域的跨频谱PAD,在跨成像条件评价模型时揭示了巨大的性能差距。 扩大这一范围,[15]研究了数据扩充战略,发现天真结合会损害性能,强调需要有条理的扩充. 针对这一问题,[26] 提出了单一域动态通用框架,仅使用一个数据集模拟域位变化,而[30] 利用对抗性增强来生成挑战性的培训样本,而不需要目标域数据。

blocks.en:
These limitations naturally led to the exploration of open-set PAD, where attack types during testing are unseen. [ 4 ] demonstrated that most existing methods fail in such settings, motivating a shift toward anomaly detection and one-class learning approaches that do not rely on predefined attack categories.
At the same time, researchers improved feature learning using attention and fusion strategies. [ 34 ] introduced attention mechanisms to help models focus on important iris regions, while [ 8 ] extended this idea with a multilevel fusion framework that separates global and local attack cues, achieving strong performance in recent benchmarks.
Another important direction considers visible-spectrum and periocular-based PAD, as most earlier works focus on NIR images. [ 42 ] explored PAD in RGB images and showed that performance drops significantly across datasets, reinforcing the generalisation problem. To mitigate data scarcity, [ 28 ] demonstrated that synthetic periocular data can partially improve training, especially when real attack samples are limited.
In parallel, privacy concerns have driven research into synthetic and privacy-preserving training. [ 31 ] showed that PAD models can be trained entirely on synthetic iris data without using real subjects, addressing ethical challenges. This aligns with benchmark efforts such as LivDet-Iris 2023 [ 37 ] , which introduced GAN-generated attacks into evaluation protocols. Further advancing this direction, [ 3 ] proposed forensic iris synthesis to generate realistic attack samples and analyse model weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
这些限制自然导致探索开放的PAD,在测试中攻击类型是看不见的. [4] 表明,大多数现有方法在这种环境下都失败了,促使人们转向异常检测和不依赖预先界定的攻击类别的一流学习方法。
与此同时,研究人员利用关注和聚变战略改进了特色学习。 [34]引入了关注机制,以帮助模型聚焦于重要的虹膜区域,而[8]则扩展了这一想法,采用了一个将全球和地方攻击提示分开的多层次聚变框架,在最近的基准中实现了强效.
另一个重要方向是考虑可见光谱和视网膜PAD,因为以前大多数工作的重点是国家清单报告图像。 [42]在RGB图像中探索了PAD,并显示各数据集的性能显著下降,强化了泛化问题. 为了缓解数据稀缺,[28]表明合成的透视数据可以部分改善训练,特别是在真实攻击样本有限的情况下.
与此同时,对隐私的关切推动了对合成和隐私保护培训的研究。 [31] 显示PAD模型可以完全接受合成虹膜数据的培训,而不使用真实的主题,应对道德挑战. 这与LivDet-Iris 2023[37]等基准努力一致,将GAN生成的攻击引入评价协议. 进一步推进这个方向,[3]提出了法医学虹膜合成,以生成现实的攻击样本和分析模型弱点.

blocks.en:
More recently, foundation models and large vision models have started influencing iris PAD. [ 36 ] showed that features from pretrained models such as DINOv2 can outperform traditional approaches when data is limited, while [ 17 ] explored zero-shot iris analysis using large language-vision models, opening new research directions. Complementing these developments, [ 47 ] provided a comprehensive survey highlighting the growing role of transformer-based models in iris-related tasks.
The LivDet-Iris competitions remain the primary benchmark for evaluating PAD systems. The 2023 edition [ 37 ] introduced diverse attack types including synthetic irises, while the 2025 edition [ 27 ] further expanded the evaluation to include unknown attacks, dataset aging, and morphing-based attacks, reinforcing the need for robust and generalisable PAD solutions.
blocks.zh:
最近,基础模型和大型视觉模型开始影响虹膜PAD. [36] 显示来自DINOv2等预先训练过的模型的特征可以在数据有限时超越传统方法,而[17]则利用大型语言视觉模型探索了零镜头虹膜分析,开启了新的研究方向. 作为对这些发展的补充,[47]提供了一份全面调查,突出强调了基于变压器的模型在虹膜相关任务中日益重要的作用。
LivDet-Iris比赛仍然是评价PAD系统的主要基准。 2023年版[37]引入了包括合成虹膜在内的多种攻击类型,而2025年版[27]则进一步扩大了评价范围,将未知攻击,数据集老化,形态攻击等包括进来,强化了对强力且通用的PAD解决方案的需求.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Diff-IrisPAD is an unsupervised iris PAD framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency.
blocks.zh: Diff-IrisPAD是一个基于Brownian Bridge Difusion的无人监督的iris PAD框架,它模拟善意的iris分布,并通过重建不一致来检测攻击.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of Diff-IrisPAD
blocks.zh: 3.1 Diff-IrisPAD概览

blocks.en:
The proposed Diff-IrisPAD framework follows a reconstruction-based learning paradigm, as illustrated in Figure. 1 . The model is trained exclusively on bona fide iris images, where each clean sample is paired with a synthetically degraded version. A diffusion model learns to reconstruct clean iris textures from these degraded inputs.
During inference, both bona fide and attack samples are processed through the same reconstruction pipeline. Since the model captures only the distribution of genuine iris images, it reconstructs bona fide samples accurately while failing to reproduce artifacts present in attack samples. This difference in reconstruction quality is used to distinguish between bona fide and presentation attacks. The overall framework consists of three stages: (i) diffusion-based reconstruction, (ii) computation of reconstruction and trajectory-based scores, and (iii) threshold-based decision making.
blocks.zh:
如图所示,拟议的Diff-IrisPAD框架遵循基于重建的学习模式。 1,该模型专门以善意虹膜图像培训,每个清洁样品都配以合成降解版本. 一个传播模型学习从这些退化的投入中重建干净的虹膜纹理.
在推论期间,通过同一重建管道处理善意和攻击样品。 由于模型只捕捉到真实的虹膜图像的分布,它精确地重建了善意的样本,同时未能复制攻击样本中的文物. 重建质量的这种差异被用来区分善意攻击和展示攻击。 总体框架包括三个阶段:(一) 基于传播的重建,(二) 基于重建和轨迹的分数的计算,(三) 基于门槛的决策。

blocks.en: 3.2 Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 布朗式桥体扩散模型

blocks.en:
Standard denoising diffusion models (DDPMs) learn a noise-to-data mapping, which is inefficient for paired image tasks. In contrast, Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models (BBDM) [ 25 ] learn a direct mapping between source and target images using a stochastic bridge process.
We adopt the BBDM [ 25 ] to learn a mapping between degraded and clean iris images. Unlike standard DDPMs [ 19 ] , which model a noise-to-data trajectory, BBDM directly learns a stochastic bridge between paired images, enabling more efficient reconstruction.
blocks.zh:

我们通过BBDM[25]来了解退化和清洁的虹膜图像之间的映射. 与标准DDPM [19] 不同的是,BBDM 直接学习成对图像之间的斜桥,从而能够更有效地重建.

blocks.en: 3.3 Unsupervised Iris PAD Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.3 无人监管的Iris PAD 拟订

blocks.en:
Unlike conventional PAD methods that require both bona fide and attack samples, our approach formulates iris PAD as an unsupervised reconstruction problem.
During training, only bona fide iris images are used. For each image 𝐲 \mathbf{y} , a degraded version 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} is generated using a degradation function: 𝐱 0 = 𝒞 ⁡ ( 𝐲 ) , \mathbf{x}_{0}=\mathcal{C}(\mathbf{y}), (2) where 𝒞 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{C}(\cdot) includes noise injection, blurring, and resolution degradation. The degradation function applies only structure-preserving corruptions rather than simulating presentation attacks. This allows Diff-IrisPAD to learn the bona fide iris manifold from paired clean and degraded images, treating attack samples as out-of-distribution during inference.
The model is trained to reconstruct 𝐲 \mathbf{y} from 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} , thereby learning the distribution of genuine iris textures.
At inference, both bona fide and attack samples are processed in the same manner. Since the model has only learned bona fide characteristics, it generalizes poorly to attack samples, resulting in higher reconstruction errors. This enables detection of unseen presentation attacks without requiring attack data during training. This effectively treats presentation attacks as out-of-distribution samples relative to the learned bona fide manifold.

blocks.zh: 3.4 Diff-IrisPAD (英语). 建筑

blocks.en: We adopt the LBBDM-f4 framework [ 25 ] , which operates in a compressed latent space obtained using a frozen VQ-f4 encoder [ 14 ] . This latent representation reduces spatial redundancy while preserving fine-grained iris texture essential for PAD. The encoder uses an embedding dimension of 3, a codebook size of 8,192, and performs 4 × 4\times spatial downsampling.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了LBBDM-f4框架[25],在使用冷冻VQ-f4编码器获得的压缩潜伏空间中运行 [14]. 这种潜在的表述减少了空间冗余,同时保留了PAD必不可少的细纹虹膜纹理。 编码器使用嵌入维度为3,编码本尺寸为8,192,并进行4×4\时空下取样.

blocks.en: The denoising process is modeled using a UNet backbone with model_channels = 128 =128 and channel multipliers [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] [1,2,3,4] . blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed Diff-IrisPAD framework on a large-scale multi-sensor iris PAD benchmark under diverse attack conditions. The experiments are designed to assess both detection performance and generalization to unseen attacks.

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed method on a comprehensive iris PAD benchmark comprising both bona fide and diverse attack samples. blocks.en: 4.2 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.2 预处理

blocks.en: All 125,854 iris images are preprocessed using a unified pipeline and resized to a fixed resolution of 256 × 256 256{\times}256 RGB format for training, validation, and testing.
blocks.zh: 所有125,854个虹膜图像都使用统一的管道进行预处理,并调整为256×256 256\times}256RGB格式的固定分辨率,用于培训,验证和测试.

blocks.en: Iris localisation: To handle variability in sensor, resolution, and framing, we localise the iris region using the Circular Hough Transform [ 21 ] . Each image is first downscaled to a 512-pixel thumbnail for efficient processing, followed by grayscale conversion, Gaussian smoothing ( 5 × 5 5{\times}5 ), and CLAHE-based contrast enhancement. Circle detection is then performed using cv2.HoughCircles , and the detected region is mapped back to the original resolution and cropped with a small radial margin. When detection fails, a centre-crop fallback is applied to ensure robustness. All crops are resized to 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and converted to RGB.
blocks.zh: Iris 本地化 : 为了处理传感器、分辨率和框架的变异性,我们利用“圆锥角变换”将虹膜区域定位。 每个图像首先被降级为512像素缩略图,以高效处理,随后是灰色缩略图转换,高斯平滑(5×5 5×time}5),以及基于CLAHE的对比增强. 然后使用cv2.HoughCircles进行圆圈检测,检测到的区域被映射回原分辨率,并用小的光圈边角进行裁剪. 当检测失败时,将采用中心作物折返,以确保稳健性。 所有作物的大小都调整到256×256 256\时}256,并转换为RGB.

blocks.en: Degradation modelling: To facilitate paired learning, degraded inputs are generated from clean iris crops through a deterministic three-stage process comprising additive Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur, and resolution degradation via downsampling and upsampling. All parameters are deterministically seeded based on the image filename, ensuring consistent and reproducible transformations across training and inference. Data split: The dataset is divided into training and validation sets using only bona fide samples, ensuring no attack images are seen during training. The degradation process introduces substantial variation, enabling robust learning of clean iris representations.
blocks.zh: 退化建模: 为了促进对等学习,通过一个确定性的三阶段过程,从清洁的虹膜作物中产生退化的投入,这一过程包括添加剂高斯噪音、高斯模糊度和通过下取样和上取样的分辨率降解。 所有参数都根据图像文件名进行定型播种,确保在整个培训和推论中实现一致和可复制的转变。 数据分割 : 数据集分为只使用善意样本的培训和验证集,确保培训期间不看到攻击图像。 退化过程带来了巨大的差异,使得人们能够积极学习干净的虹膜表达。

Evaluation uses a merged ZAK attack pool (50,612 samples) against 12,926 bona-fide test images, while 5,276 validation bona-fide images are reserved solely for threshold calibration.

blocks.en: 4.3 Bona Fide Pair Construction
blocks.zh: 4.3 Bona Fide Pair建筑工程

blocks.en:
To enable unsupervised learning, we construct paired training data using only bona fide iris images. Each clean image is paired with a synthetically degraded version generated through a deterministic degradation pipeline, as shown in Figure. 1 .
The degradation process consists of three sequential steps: (i) Gaussian noise injection, (ii) Gaussian blur, and (iii) resolution degradation via downsampling and upsampling. The degradation parameters are randomly sampled within predefined ranges but remain deterministic for each image using a filename-based seed, ensuring reproducibility.
Formally, for each clean image 𝐲 \mathbf{y} , a degraded counterpart 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} is generated as: 𝐱 0 = 𝒞 ⁡ ( 𝐲 ) , \mathbf{x}_{0}=\mathcal{C}(\mathbf{y}), (10) where 𝒞 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{C}(\cdot) denotes the degradation function. The resulting dataset consists of aligned pairs ( 𝐱 0 , 𝐲 ) (\mathbf{x}_{0},\mathbf{y}) , where 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} serves as the input and 𝐲 \mathbf{y} as the reconstruction target.
Importantly, only bona fide images are used during training, and spoof samples are explicitly excluded to enforce an unsupervised learning paradigm.
4.4 Training and Evaluation Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 4.4 培训和评价数据集建设

blocks.en:
For training, we use the constructed bona fide pairs, where corrupted images act as inputs and clean images as targets. The dataset is organized into aligned directories to ensure one-to-one correspondence between input-output pairs during training.
During evaluation, both bona fide and attack samples are considered. Clean images are first loaded and then corrupted on-the-fly using the same deterministic pipeline employed during training. This ensures consistency between training and testing distributions while enabling fair evaluation of PAD performance.
Each evaluation sample is associated with a label (bonafide or attack) and an attack type, allowing detailed performance analysis across different attack categories. The evaluation dataset is organized in a structured format with corresponding labels, ensuring compatibility with standard PAD evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh:
在训练方面,我们使用已建成的善意对子,其中腐烂的图像作为投入,干净的图像作为目标。 数据集编成对齐的目录,以确保培训期间输入输出对对之间的一对对应.
在评价期间,考虑善意和攻击性样品。 清洁图像首先装上,然后利用训练期间使用的同样的确定性管道在飞行中损坏。 这确保了培训和测试分配的一致性,同时能够公平评价项目开发与发展的业绩。
每个评价样本都与标签(bonafide或攻击)和攻击类型相关联,可以对不同攻击类别进行详细的性能分析. 评价数据集采用结构化格式,并附有相应的标签,确保与标准的PAD评价协议兼容.

blocks.en: 4.5 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.5 执行细节

blocks.en: Diff-IrisPAD is implemented in PyTorch using the LBBDM-f4 configuration. Images are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and encoded into a 64 × 64 64\times 64 latent space using a pretrained VQGAN. The model is trained on bona fide pairs with GPU acceleration. Evaluation follows a standard pipeline with validation-based threshold optimization.
blocks.zh: Diff-IrisPAD在PyTorch使用LBBDM-f4配置实现. 图像的大小调整为256×256 256\times 256,并使用预先训练的VQGAN编码为64×64\times 64潜伏空间. 该型号通过GPU加速度的善意对子训练. 评价遵循基于验证的阈值优化的标准管道。

blocks.en: 4.6 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 4.6 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares Diff-IrisPAD with diffusion-based iris PAD methods under a consistent unsupervised setting. The baseline AnoDDPM exhibits high error rates and unstable performance across attack types, with particularly large ACER values for Contact Lens (48.45), Generated (48.95), and Print & E-display (54.07), resulting in a high overall ACER of 49.17.
In contrast, Diff-IrisPAD consistently achieves lower error rates across all attack categories. Notably, it obtains the lowest ACER for Artifact (6.08), Fake with Add-On (7.01), Post-Mortem (7.82), and Print & E-display (25.41), while also reducing error on challenging attacks such as E-display (25.33) and Generated (46.96).
Overall, Diff-IrisPAD achieves a substantially lower average ACER of 30.52 , significantly outperforming AnoDDPM. This improvement demonstrates that modeling bona fide iris distributions via Brownian Bridge Diffusion enables more stable and accurate detection compared to generic diffusion-based reconstruction approaches.

表2 比较 Diff-IrisPAD在一致的无监督设置下采用基于扩散的irisPAD方法. 基线AnoDDPM显示各种攻击类型的误差率高,性能不稳定,接触镜头的ACER值特别大(48.45),生成(48.95),以及Prind & E-display(54.07),导致总体ACER值高达49.17.
相比之下,Diff-IrisPAD在所有攻击类别中始终实现了较低的错误率. 值得注意的是,它为Artifact(6.08)、Ad-On(7.01)、Post-Mortem(7.82)和Princess & E-Display(25.41)获取了最低的ACER,同时也减少了E-Display(25.33)和Generated(46.96)。
总体而言,Diff-IrisPAD的平均排减量大大低于30.52,明显高于AnoDDPM。 这一改进表明,与通用的传播式重建方法相比,通过Brownian Bridge传播制作善意虹膜分配模型能够更稳定和准确地检测。

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison under the ZAK protocol, we compare Diff-IrisPAD with AnoDDPM, the closest diffusion-based unsupervised baseline, and f-AnoGAN, a representative GAN-based anomaly detection method. This comparison evaluates whether the observed improvements arise from the proposed DiffIrisPAD model formulation rather than reconstruction-based anomaly detection alone.

blocks.en: 4.7 Generalization to Unseen Attacks
blocks.zh: 4.7 普遍化为不明攻击

blocks.en:
Table 3 illustrates the challenges of unseen attacks and the limitations of attack-dependent learning, thereby motivating the proposed attack-independent bona fide modeling approach. It presents the leave-one-attack-out (LOO) evaluation, where models are trained by excluding one attack type and evaluated on the corresponding unseen attack.
Supervised models, including CNN (ResNet50), transformer (ViT-B, MaxViT), and foundation models (DINOv1, DINOv2), achieve strong performance on certain attack types but exhibit significant variability across unseen conditions. In particular, high ACER values are observed for challenging attacks such as Contact Lens (e.g., 0.497 for ResNet50, 0.488 for DINOv1) and Artifact (e.g., 0.399 for ResNet50), indicating limited robustness when attack characteristics differ from training data.
Transformer and foundation models show improved performance on some attacks (e.g., DINOv2 achieves low ACER for Printed and Fake with Add-On), but still lack consistent generalization across all attack types.
These results highlight that supervised methods, while effective on known attacks, are sensitive to distribution shifts. In contrast, Diff-IrisPAD, trained solely on bona fide samples, avoids reliance on attack-specific supervision and is inherently better suited for open-set scenarios. By modeling the distribution of genuine iris textures, it provides a more robust and stable framework for detecting unseen presentation attacks.

表3说明了隐形攻击的挑战和依赖攻击的学习的局限性,从而激发了拟议的独立攻击的善意模式。 报告介绍了 " 留一攻击 " (LOO)评价,其中通过排除一种攻击类型来培训模型,并评价相应的未见攻击。
监督型号,包括CNN(ResNet50),变压器(ViT-B,MaxViT),以及基础型号(DINOv1,DINOv2),在某些攻击型号上都取得了强大的性能,但在整个未知条件下表现出显著的变异性. 特别是,对于挑战性攻击,如Contact Lens(如ResNet50的0.497,DINov1的0.488)和Artifact(如ResNet50的0.399),观察到了较高的ACER值,表明攻击特性与训练数据不同时强度有限.
变形器和基础模型显示一些攻击的性能有所改进(例如,DINOv2实现印刷和装配Add-On的低ACER),但在所有攻击类型中仍然缺乏一致的概括.
这些结果突出表明,受监督的方法虽然对已知的攻击有效,但对分配变化很敏感。 与此相对照,仅接受诚信样本培训的Diff-IrisPAD避免依赖针对特定攻击的监管,并且本质上更适合开放式设定情景. 通过模拟真虹膜纹理的分布,它为探测未见的呈现攻击提供了更坚固稳定的框架.

blocks.en: Reconstruction and Error Analysis. Figure 3 shows qualitative reconstruction results and corresponding error maps across different samples. Bona fide inputs are reconstructed accurately with low error responses, while attack samples exhibit noticeable reconstruction discrepancies and higher error regions. These high-error regions correspond to deviations from the learned bona fide distribution, particularly around iris texture and boundary areas. This behavior confirms that Diff-IrisPAD effectively captures genuine iris characteristics while failing to reconstruct attack-specific artifacts, enabling reliable separation between bona fide and attack samples.

blocks.en: 5.1 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.1 读取研究

blocks.en:
Effect of Denoising Steps: Table 4 evaluates the impact of DDIM denoising steps ( T T ) on PAD performance. Increasing T T improves reconstruction quality and stabilizes detection across attack types.
Low step counts ( T = 10 T{=}10 ) offer fast inference (84.4 ms/img) but result in higher ACER due to limited reconstruction fidelity. Increasing to T = 50 T{=}50 significantly improves stability across challenging attacks such as E-display and Generated samples.
The best performance is achieved at T = 100 T{=}100 , yielding the lowest overall ACER of 30.52 with consistent APCER/BPCER across attacks, indicating an optimal balance between accuracy and efficiency. While further increasing to T = 200 T{=}200 provides marginal gains in certain cases (e.g., Artifact), it leads to higher computational cost (671.9 ms/img) without improving overall performance.
Overall, moderate denoising steps ( T = 100 T{=}100 ) are sufficient to capture discriminative iris structures while maintaining computational efficiency.

blocks.en: Limitations. Diff-IrisPAD depends on effective degradation modeling; mismatched synthetic degradations can reduce reconstruction quality. It may also struggle with highly realistic attacks that closely resemble bona fide iris textures.
blocks.zh: 限制。 Diff-IrisPAD依赖于有效的降解模型;不匹配的合成降解可以降低重建质量. 它也可能遇到非常现实的攻击,这些攻击与真正的虹膜纹理非常相似。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised iris PAD framework based on BBDM model. By learning only the bona fide iris manifold, it eliminates the need for attack samples and achieves an ACER of 30.52, outperforming AnoDDPM & f-AnoGAN. These results demonstrate that attack independent bona fide modeling improves generalization to unseen presentation attacks under the ZAK protocol. Future work will investigate adaptive degradation and cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了Diff-IrisPAD,这是一个基于BBDM模型的无人监管的irisPAD框架. 通过只学习真正的虹膜多面体,它消除了对攻击样品的需求,并实现了30.52的ACER, 表现优于AnoDDPM & f-AnoGAN. 这些结果表明,根据ZAK协议,攻击的独立善意模型可以改进对隐形展示攻击的概括。 今后的工作将调查适应性退化和跨领域普遍化。
